resources.string: The FusedLocation service is not installed in this environment.
FusedLocation permission is required to use the SDK.
Register an alert around the latest received position. The center stays fixed until the alert is removed.
The latest received position will become the center when you register.
Receive a location first using Start live updates or Get last known location.
Mock test: Inside injects the registered center; Outside injects a point three radii away. This changes the received location and does not represent actual movement.
